method: Context-aware action-conditioned cross-attention student with action-only negative control
purpose: Evaluate a redesigned context-aware action-conditioned cross-attention student using train-only teacher data, calibration-only fixed-M selection, and one held-out offline screen.
claim_boundary: Stage A is offline ranking and readiness evidence only. It does not authorize student-updated chained CEM, latency, native system timing, memory, or closed-loop claims.

prior_failed_recipe.interpretation: V1 is retained as a prior failed recipe. Its no-go is not hidden, reinterpreted, or converted into a V2 result.
prior_failed_recipe.v2_relation: V2 is an architecture/data redesign with a newly frozen split and gate; do not retune V1 gates or pool V1 observations into V2.

scope.independence_unit: one independent Wall observation with one complete ten-round full-teacher CEM chain

fixed_settings.objective: Existing DINO-WM Wall planner objective; lower is better.
fixed_settings.tie_break: Stable ascending candidate-index tie-break after objective or score value.
fixed_settings.candidate_population_rule: J_full and both student score arrays in each call describe the identical 300-candidate population.
fixed_settings.chain_rule: The full teacher alone updates chained CEM distributions; student and action-only scores are offline ranking observations and never update mu or sigma.
fixed_settings.checkpoint_and_preprocessing: Teacher and student records use the V2 observation/action preprocessing contract; no V1 record or checkpoint is pooled into V2.

context_aware_student.context_tokens: candidate-independent z0 and zgoal visual/proprio context tokens
context_aware_student.action_tokens: candidate action sequence tokens for each H=5 action sequence
context_aware_student.fusion: action-conditioned cross-attention from action queries to context tokens

training.teacher_data_record_unit: one train observation containing all ten chained rounds
training.required_teacher_data: Each train observation has exactly ten rounds; each round records 300 finite candidate actions, 300 finite J_full values, and full-teacher CEM update states.
training.summary_array_policy: Training and verifier summaries must contain compact counts/medians/minima only; raw candidate/action/score arrays belong only in JSONL records.

evaluation_records.record_unit: one observation containing all ten chained full-teacher rounds
evaluation_records.ranking_rule: The verifier stably ranks each 300-value array by (value, candidate index); recorded top-M lists and recall values are non-authoritative.

required_arrays.candidate_actions: A non-empty finite numeric array whose first dimension has length 300.
required_arrays.student_context_scores: Exactly 300 finite numeric values, lower is better.
required_arrays.student_action_only_scores: Exactly 300 finite numeric values, lower is better.

teacher_update.chain_continuity: For round r>0, input_mu and input_sigma equal the same observation's preceding output_mu and output_sigma.

selection_gate.call_definition: One observation-round pair; calibration has 8 observations x 10 rounds = 80 calls.
selection_gate.context_rule: Select the smallest M whose calibration context-aware recall has median exactly 1.0 and minimum at least 29/30.
selection_gate.action_only_rule: Report the same calibration metrics for action-only control; it is a negative control and is not a pass/fail gate.

heldout_gate.context_rule: At the one calibration-selected fixed M, heldout context-aware recall has median exactly 1.0 and minimum at least 29/30.
heldout_gate.action_only_rule: Report heldout action-only recall at the selected M; it does not determine the verdict.

result_decision.pass_verdict: PASS only when contract, V2 split/schema/completeness, train-only provenance, V2 architecture identity, calibration selection, and heldout context-aware gates all pass.
result_decision.pass_authorizes: A later separately frozen chained Stage B using the selected fixed M.

prohibited: Do not tune selected M using heldout records.
Do not train the V2 student or action-only control on calibration or heldout observations.
Do not let student scores update CEM mu or sigma in Stage A.
Do not pool V1 observations, V1 checkpoints, or V1 no-go outcomes into V2 metrics.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for recorded values or comparisons.
Do not infer latency, native deployment, or closed-loop behavior from this offline screen.
